name: Captain America (Marvel)
snapshot: Fitted navy blue tactical suit with white chest star, bold red-and-white vertical torso stripes, brown leather harness/utility belt, and dark red boots and gloves.
palette: Primary: Navy Blue | Secondary: Clean White | Accent: Crimson Red | Detail: Saddle Brown Leather
outfit: Navy blue Harrington jacket or bomber over a crisp white crew-neck tee, dark wash raw denim jeans, classic red retro sneakers (e.g., Nike Cortez or Adidas Gazelle), and a brown leather watch/belt.
tip: Keep the blue dark and matte rather than bright royal to ground the look; let red pop only on the footwear or subtle accessory accents.

name: Itadori (JJK)
snapshot: Dark navy Jujutsu High high-collared uniform jacket with iconic crimson red hooded cowl underneath, matching dark navy trousers, and red-and-white athletic high-tops.
palette: Primary: Deep Navy / Black | Contrast: Crimson Red | Accent: White
outfit: Crimson red pullover hoodie layered under a cropped dark navy work jacket or overshirt, relaxed navy or black straight-leg trousers, and red-and-white skate/court sneakers (e.g., Nike Dunk Low Chicago).
tip: The layered red hood peeking out of a structured dark jacket is Yuji's unmistakable signature silhouette.

name: Inuyasha (Inuyasha)
snapshot: Billowing bright scarlet red robe of the fire-rat (haori and wide hakama), crisp white undershirt collar, black beaded prayer necklace, and long silver-white hair.
palette: Primary: Scarlet Red | Secondary: Pure White | Accent: Jet Black / Silver
outfit: Scarlet red relaxed knit cardigan or overshirt over a crisp white tee, black relaxed pleated trousers, black leather loafers or slip-on shoes, and a subtle black beaded cord necklace.
tip: Balance the bold red dominance with clean neutral white and black base pieces so the outfit stays sophisticated.

name: Deku (MHA)
snapshot: Teal-green hero jumpsuit with black utility lines, white segmented gloves, dark respirator mask, and oversized chunky red high-top combat sneakers with black soles.
palette: Primary: Forest / Teal Green | Secondary: Jet Black | Accent: Bright Red | Detail: White
outfit: Forest green zip hoodie or chore coat, black graphic tee or white mock neck, black cargo pants, and chunky high-top red sneakers (e.g., Air Jordan 1s or red Converse All Stars).
tip: Deku's hallmark is the red sneaker anchor against a dark green/black utilitarian silhouette.

name: Megumi (JJK)
snapshot: Minimalist, clean-cut dark navy high-collared Jujutsu High uniform tunic and tapered trousers, black combat boots, dark spiky hair, and green shadow hound energy.
palette: Primary: Midnight Navy | Secondary: Jet Black | Accent: Forest / Olive Green
outfit: Dark navy mandarin-collar or stand-collar overshirt, fitted black tee, tailored navy trousers or tapered black pants, and minimalist black Chelsea boots with a dark green beanie or tote.
tip: Monochromatic, sleek, utilitarian elegance; keep cuts sharp and tailored to channel his composed, calculating demeanor.

name: Tanjiro (KNY)
snapshot: Iconic black-and-green checkerboard (ichimatsu) haori over dark brown Demon Slayer Corps gakuran uniform with white calf wraps and hanafuda earrings.
palette: Primary: Forest Green | Secondary: Jet Black | Accent: Warm Brown | Detail: Crisp White
outfit: Dark green-and-black buffalo check flannel overshirt (or solid forest green cardigan) over a white tee, dark chocolate brown or charcoal chinos, and black leather boots with white socks peeking out.
tip: An oversized green-and-black check flannel is an effortless, stylish everyday nod to Tanjiro's haori.

name: Tomioka (KMY)
snapshot: Split half-and-half haori: solid dark wine/crimson red on the right, geometric green/yellow/orange cubes on the left, over dark brown uniform and white leg wraps.
palette: Primary: Deep Wine / Crimson Red | Contrast: Forest Green | Accent: Mustard Yellow | Neutral: White / Black
outfit: Deep wine/burgundy crew-neck sweater or bomber jacket, paired with a green-and-yellow geometric patterned scarf or mustard beanie, dark charcoal trousers, and clean white minimalist sneakers.
tip: Instead of literal split clothing, wear a solid burgundy top and incorporate mustard yellow and green through subtle accessories.

name: Archer (Fate)
snapshot: Sleek black sleeveless compression undershirt and black combat trousers wrapped in a distinctive open crimson red holy shroud trench coat with metallic silver buckles.
palette: Primary: Jet Black | Contrast: Crimson Red | Accent: Metallic Silver / White
outfit: Black ribbed mock-neck sweater or fitted tee, black slim-fit denim or moto pants, a crimson red long trench coat, wool overcoat, or red chore jacket, finished with black combat boots and silver jewelry.
tip: Let the crimson red outerwear be the dramatic statement piece over a sleek, all-black tailored foundation.

name: Gon (HxH)
snapshot: Bright green zip-up jacket with contrast orange collar/hem piping, matching green short-shorts, black tank undershirt, and green/black laced boots.
palette: Primary: Kelly / Forest Green | Accent: Bright Orange | Base: Black / White
outfit: Forest green sporty track jacket or zip windbreaker with orange zip/piping details, black cargo shorts or black relaxed denim, and green-and-orange retro runners (e.g., Le Coq Sportif or Asics Gel-Lyte).
tip: Lean into retro 90s streetwear / gorpcore aesthetics; keep the green sporty and balance with muted black pants.

name: Rengoku (KNY)
snapshot: White haori flaring into fiery red-and-yellow jagged flame ridges along the hem, dark brown Demon Slayer uniform, and flame-patterned calf guards.
palette: Primary: Warm White | Secondary: Flame Orange / Golden Yellow | Accent: Deep Crimson Red | Base: Charcoal
outfit: Off-white/cream textured knit sweater or worker jacket, paired with a warm rust/burnt orange scarf or beanie, dark brown/charcoal trousers, and warm tan or oxblood leather boots.
tip: Use warm autumnal shades (cream, rust, mustard, burgundy) to capture his blazing fiery spirit with high-end, cozy elegance.

name: Naruto (Naruto)
snapshot: Bright orange two-tone tracksuit jacket with royal blue shoulders and white shearling-lined collar, matching baggy orange pants, and blue shinobi sandals.
palette: Primary: Vivid Orange | Contrast: Royal Blue | Accent: Clean White
outfit: Royal blue corduroy or denim jacket over an orange graphic tee (or orange hoodie under a navy denim jacket), white relaxed carpenter pants or dark blue jeans, and blue-and-white sneakers.
tip: Navy or royal blue denim softens the bright orange top, keeping the iconic colorway balanced and wearable for daily life.

name: Naruto (Naruto Shippuden)
snapshot: Mature black-and-orange zip tracksuit jacket with broad black shoulders/chest bands, matching orange pants with black holster bandage, and black shinobi sandals.
palette: Primary: Jet Black | Contrast: Vibrant Orange | Accent: White
outfit: Black fleece or track jacket with bold orange color-blocking, black relaxed cargo pants or joggers, and black-and-orange sneakers (e.g., Nike Air Max or Jordan 1 Shattered Backboard).
tip: Black takes the dominant role here with orange as the powerful accent panel, giving an edgy, modern athletic look.

name: Naruto Sage (Naruto)
snapshot: Shippuden black-and-orange suit overlaid with an iconic long sleeveless crimson red-and-black flame-bordered Sage haori cloak and giant tan scroll on back.
palette: Primary: Crimson Red | Secondary: Jet Black | Accent: Orange | Detail: Ochre / Tan
outfit: Crimson red long duster coat or kimono-style noragi cardigan over an all-black tee and black denim, accented with an orange beanie or watch and tan canvas backpack/messenger bag.
tip: The long red coat over an all-black base instantly evokes the epic Sage mode silhouette.

name: Alice (SAO)
snapshot: Gleaming golden knight plate armor, rich royal blue capes/skirts, white lace undergarments, and braided golden-blonde hair.
palette: Primary: Royal Blue | Contrast: Pure White | Accent: Metallic Gold / Brass
outfit: Royal blue structured blazer or tailored wool trench, crisp white button-down shirt, cream or white tailored trousers, polished brown/gold-buckled loafers, and gold jewelry accents.
tip: Crisp, regal tailoring; gold accessories (watches, belt buckles, jewelry) evoke knightly prestige against royal blue.

name: Ironman (Marvel)
snapshot: Crimson and metallic hot-rod gold biomechanical armor with glowing cyan/white arc reactor on chest, or Tony's tailored suit with tinted shades.
palette: Primary: Crimson / Cherry Red | Contrast: Metallic Gold / Brass | Base: Black / Beige | Accent: Ice Cyan
outfit: Deep crimson red fitted tee or knit sweater, tailored beige/camel chinos, black leather bomber jacket, gold watch/cuff, and sleek sneakers with subtle blue accents.
tip: High-tech billionaire casual: sleek leather, warm camel pants, cherry red statement knit, and sharp gold metallic hardware.

name: Robin (DC Comics)
snapshot: Bright red reinforced tunic/vest, forest green sleeves/gloves and pants, bright yellow utility belt and cape lining, and black domino mask.
palette: Primary: Forest Green | Contrast: Scarlet / Crimson Red | Accent: Golden Yellow | Base: Jet Black
outfit: Olive/forest green utility field jacket or cargo pants, paired with a washed red graphic tee or crimson hoodie, black leather boots, and subtle yellow/brass brass-toned hardware.
tip: Muted olive/army green grounds vibrant crimson red, turning an acrobatic superhero suit into rugged military/workwear street style.

name: Survey Corps - Eren / Levi (Attack on Titan)
snapshot: Deep hooded forest green Survey Corps cape featuring the "Wings of Freedom" crest, crisp white button-up collar shirt, beige/tan cropped leather jacket, white riding trousers, and knee-high dark brown boots.
palette: Primary: Forest Green | Secondary: Pure White | Neutral: Tan / Leather Brown | Accent: Steel Grey
outfit: Forest green hooded parka or long military coat over a crisp white grandad-collar shirt, off-white/cream straight-leg trousers, and dark brown leather lace-up boots.
tip: The crisp white shirt and cream trousers paired with military green outerwear captures the refined Scouting Legion aesthetic.

name: Black Star (Soul Eater)
snapshot: Sleeveless black sleeveless turtleneck tunic with a large white star shoulder tattoo, white baggy hakama-style ninja pants with black knee straps, and bright electric blue spiky hair.
palette: Primary: Electric / Cyan Blue | Secondary: Pure White | Base: Jet Black
outfit: Electric cyan or sky blue crew-neck sweatshirt over a white tee, relaxed black cargo pants with strap details, clean white skate sneakers, and a black canvas belt.
tip: Athleisure meets 2000s techwear; use bold cyan blue accents to channel Black☆Star's exuberant ninja star power.

name: Natsu (Fairy Tail)
snapshot: One-sleeved black open vest with gold trim, baggy white knee-length pants tied with a black sash, Igneel's signature white scale-pattern scarf, and salmon-pink spiky hair.
palette: Primary: Jet Black | Contrast: Warm White | Accent: Golden Yellow | Pop: Coral / Salmon Pink
outfit: Black overshirt or open utility vest with gold snap buttons, white waffle-knit tee or white textured scarf, white or off-white relaxed trousers, black sandals or sneakers, and salmon-pink socks or cap.
tip: A textured white waffle scarf against an open black jacket is the quintessential, modern nod to Natsu's dragon-scale scarf.

name: Batman (DC Comics)
snapshot: Stealth matte-black armored cowl, cape, and gauntlets over dark charcoal/slate ballistic torso suit, prominent black bat insignia on chest, and gold/bronze utility belt.
palette: Primary: Pitch Black | Secondary: Charcoal Grey | Accent: Antique Brass / Gold
outfit: Charcoal grey crew-neck cashmere sweater under a matte black leather moto jacket (or tech trench), tailored black slim-fit denim, black Chelsea boots, and a brass/gold buckle leather belt.
tip: Ultimate urban stealth minimalism: layer varied dark textures (leather, cashmere, denim) with a solitary brass belt/watch accent.

name: Ichigo (Bleach)
snapshot: Slim full-length black shihakusho longcoat with jagged hem and bright crimson red inner silk lining, black chain tsuba, hollow mask white accents, and fiery orange hair.
palette: Primary: Jet Black | Contrast: Crimson Red | Accent: Bone White | Hair: Burnt Orange
outfit: All-black outfit (black tee, black slim trousers) anchored by a black trench coat or chore jacket featuring a red inner lining (or subtle red contrast stitching), and white high-top sneakers.
tip: Bankai chic: keep the exterior sleek and monochrome black, with red revealed dynamically as you move or layer.

name: Seshomaru (Inuyasha)
snapshot: Flowing pure white kimono robe adorned with red plum blossom crests, purple decorative shoulder ribbons, massive white fur moko-moko over shoulder, spiked steel armor pauldron, and gold crescent crest.
palette: Primary: Pristine White | Secondary: Soft Cream / Silver | Accent: Royal Purple / Crimson Red | Detail: Pale Gold
outfit: Oversized creamy white wool/fleece coat or oversized white knit cardigan, white relaxed trousers, paired with a rich purple silk scarf or purple crewneck tee, white leather sneakers, and gold jewelry.
tip: Luxurious white textures (shearling, mohair, or wool) evoke his fur sash, elevated by royal purple and crimson accents.

name: Kaneki (Tokyo Ghoul)
snapshot: Form-fitting black leather ghoul combat suit with spine/chest cutouts, metallic zipper gimp mask, stark white hair, and vivid crimson kakugan eye / kagune tentacles.
palette: Primary: Jet Black | Secondary: Stark White | Accent: Deep Plum / Purple | Pop: Blood Red
outfit: Black leather moto jacket (or black zip-up tech jacket) over a crisp white tee, charcoal/black ripped or panelled denim, black combat boots, and deep plum/burgundy socks or red eyewear.
tip: Dark avant-garde Tokyo streetwear; combine clean monochromatic black-and-white contrast with edgy zipper and hardware details.

name: Sasuke (Naruto)
snapshot: High-collared loose white short-sleeved tunic open at the chest, dark blue trousers, wrapped at the waist with an oversized thick braided purple shimenawa rope holding his kusanagi sword.
palette: Primary: Crisp White | Secondary: Deep Navy Blue | Accent: Royal Purple | Detail: Black
outfit: Relaxed off-white camp-collar or open linen shirt, deep navy tailored trousers or dark blue jeans, a purple braided woven belt or purple bandana, and minimalist dark slip-ons or sneakers.
tip: The purple rope belt translates effortlessly into a modern woven belt or statement rope accessory against an airy white top and navy pants.

name: Yuta (JJK)
snapshot: Loose, unstructured pure white Jujutsu High uniform jacket buttoned diagonally, dark navy uniform trousers, white sneakers, and dark katana sheath strap across chest.
palette: Primary: Clean White | Secondary: Deep Navy | Base: Black | Accent: Subtle Crimson
outfit: Boxy white utility work jacket or white denim overshirt over a white tee, relaxed navy pleated trousers, clean white leather retro sneakers, and a black cross-body sling bag.
tip: Effortless, clean-cut modern minimalism; the cross-body bag strap mirrors his sword sheath while white outerwear keeps it fresh.

name: Kirito (SAO)
snapshot: Floor-length jet black leather trench coat ("Coat of Midnight") with silver/white linear trim along the collar and hem, black leather chest harness, black trousers, and double sword scabbards.
palette: Primary: Pitch Black | Contrast: Silver / Stark White | Neutral: Charcoal
outfit: Long black duster coat or black car coat over a black mock-neck sweater, slim black jeans, black leather Chelsea boots, and silver metallic chain or minimalist silver watch.
tip: Monochromatic black tailored layering with intentional silver metallic hardware creates a sleek, futuristic modern silhouette.

name: Roy Mustang (FMA)
snapshot: Tailored double-breasted Amestris military officer uniform in deep royal blue with gold shoulder ropes and rank epaulets, white ignition gloves with transmutation circles, and tall black riding boots.
palette: Primary: Amestris Royal / Navy Blue | Contrast: Pure White | Base: Jet Black | Accent: Gold / Brass
outfit: Navy double-breasted tailored coat or navy peacoat over a crisp white dress shirt, tailored navy or black trousers, polished black dress shoes, white pocket square, and gold cufflinks/belt buckle.
tip: Classic sartorial elegance; military-inspired tailoring with brass/gold buttons and white accents channels the commanding Flame Alchemist.

name: Sung JinWoo (Solo Leveling)
snapshot: Long fluttering midnight-black trench coat with high collar, dark navy/black fitted tactical undershirt and combat trousers, radiating glowing neon purple and ice-blue shadow monarch aura.
palette: Primary: Obsidian Black | Secondary: Midnight Navy | Accent: Neon Purple / Electric Cyan
outfit: Long black wool overcoat or techwear trench, black slim-fit turtleneck, dark navy/black tapered trousers, black tactical boots, and subtle neon purple or cyan watch display / accessory accents.
tip: Dark, imposing "Shadow Monarch" drip; sleek tailored outerwear over an all-black base, energized with high-tech purple or electric blue accents.
